comment: The layer graph (ADR-051). This file is the single declaration: `pnpm boundaries:gen`
regenerates .dependency-cruiser.json and biome.json's `overrides` block from it, and
`pnpm boundaries:check` fails if either drifted. Edit here, never there.
`use` is the *direct* allowance; `useTypeOnly` permits `import type` only (ADR-052).
`npm`: an array is a closed-world allowlist, "non-view" is anything but `viewOnly`,
"any" is unrestricted and belongs to the one layer that may render.
`dirs` are the *policed* dirs — a package's own build scripts are Node tooling, not layer.
Each layer's allowance must stay transitively closed — the `-reach` rules assume it.

bannedSyntax.why: take the clock as an explicit `now: number`
same — no implicit clock in the kernel
host ICU + device timezone decide the output, so it cannot be hand-ported or pinned by a fixture

comment: TWO renderers, one layer (WP4-1). `apps/web` is listed here before it holds a single file,
and that ordering is the point: every rule this generator emits is keyed `from` a layer dir
and the only rule with a non-layer `from` is no-circular — so a directory absent from this
list is the `from` of NO rule at all. A new app would have been free to import
`data-normalize`, or to call an upstream HK API directly, and golden rule 2 would not have
fired. That is a gate passing because it is looking at nothing, which this repo has now hit
five times; the cheapest moment to close it is before the first file exists.

bannedSyntax.why: a literal spoken label ships English to a screen reader in a Chinese UI — use `t(locale, key)`. The `LocalizedString` brand cannot catch this one: React Native's own `accessibilityLabel` is typed `string`, so a literal on a `View`/`Pressable`/`Image` is legal TypeScript
same gap — `TextInput.placeholder` is React Native's prop and typed `string`, so only a text rule sees a literal here
hand-rolled `{n}` interpolation. Messages are ICU now: pass `t(locale, key, { n })`. `.replace()` also returns a plain `string`, which silently launders the LocalizedString brand off the result
